title: Dryden Vos
subtitle: Crimson Dawn
description: Dryden Vos was the ruthless public face of Crimson Dawn. Vos was known to have held lavish engagement aboard his yacht First Light. He appreciated the finer things the galaxy had to offer and was also known as a collector of antiquities. But underneath his façade, he was a ganster with little tolerance for failure and would kill without remorse.
